svg.title: Two scoped current dimensions: regional reach and cited width
svg.desc: Red Sea Northern Channel summer plume reach: reported 110 to 120 kilometres. Indian South Equatorial Current upstream width: cited estimate about 650 kilometres. Separate scales and evidence classes. Neither is a whole-current dimension, annual range, or measurement uncertainty.

g.text: Two regional dimensions, with their source limits
Prepared evidence • runtime integration and browser review pending
Red Sea: Northern Channel summer plume reach
Peters et al. (2005), §5b, p.578 • distance from Perim Narrows
Source extent interval using speed 0.2 m/s and salinity 38 psu contours.
Campaign: 21 Aug–12 Sep 2001; exact reach occupation dates unknown.
Existing winter 130 km report uses different support; no annual range formed.
Indian SEC: width upstream of the Mascarene Plateau
ASCLME 2008, 51-page report, p.30 • cites New et al. (2007)
Cited estimate; original attribution and measurement method remain unverified.
Width dates, depth, paired edges and numerical uncertainty: unknown.
Separate scales • regional evidence • no whole-current ranking
Neither record supplies annual extrema, observed geometry or seasonal playback.
Spitsbergen Trough Current: name candidate held; no distances admitted pending original figure review.
